fields.description: Master switch to enable or disable all Xero sync features.
fields.label: Enable Xero Synchronization

fields.description: Indicates if the connection to Xero is currently active (based on last check).
fields.label: Connection Status

fields.description: OAuth2 redirect URL configured in your Xero app (e.g., https://yoursite.com/api/method/xero.utils.xero_client.handle_oauth_callback)
fields.label: Redirect URL

fields.description: Auto-populated after connecting. To select a different Xero organisation, disconnect and reconnect.
fields.label: Tenant ID

fields.description: Control which entities sync in each direction. The directional master gates override all entity-level toggles below them.
fields.label: Sync Direction Control

fields.description: Master gate for ALL outbound syncs (ERPNext to Xero). When OFF, nothing is written to Xero regardless of individual entity toggles.
fields.label: Enable Sync TO Xero (ERPNext → Xero)

fields.description: Sync Customers and Suppliers to Xero Contacts on save.
fields.label: Contacts → Xero

fields.description: Sync Items (Products and Services) to Xero on save.
fields.label: Items → Xero

fields.description: Sync Sales Invoices (ACCREC) to Xero on submit.
fields.label: Sales Invoices → Xero

fields.description: Sync Purchase Invoices (Bills / ACCPAY) to Xero on submit.
fields.label: Bills (Purchase) → Xero

fields.description: Sync Sales and Purchase return invoices to Xero Credit Notes.
fields.label: Credit Notes → Xero

fields.description: Sync Payment Entries to Xero Payments on submit.
fields.label: Payments → Xero

fields.description: Sync submitted Journal Entries to Xero Manual Journals.
fields.label: Journal Entries → Xero

fields.description: Sync submitted Bank Transactions to Xero Bank Transactions.
fields.label: Bank Transactions → Xero

fields.description: Sync submitted Purchase Orders to Xero Purchase Orders.
fields.label: Purchase Orders → Xero

fields.description: Sync submitted Quotations to Xero Quotes.
fields.label: Quotations → Xero

fields.description: Master gate for ALL inbound syncs (Xero to ERPNext). When OFF, nothing is read from Xero regardless of individual entity toggles.
fields.label: Enable Sync FROM Xero (Xero → ERPNext)

fields.description: Sync Xero Contacts into ERPNext as Customers / Suppliers.
fields.label: Contacts ← Xero

fields.description: Also pull each Xero contact's History & Notes onto the linked Customer/Supplier as timeline Comments. Heavy: one extra Xero API call per contact, so it runs as a throttled rolling background job.
fields.label: Contact Notes ← Xero

fields.description: Sync Xero Items into ERPNext Items.
fields.label: Items ← Xero

fields.description: Sync Xero ACCREC Invoices into ERPNext Sales Invoices (created as Draft).
fields.label: Sales Invoices ← Xero

fields.description: Sync Xero ACCPAY Bills into ERPNext Purchase Invoices (created as Draft).
fields.label: Bills (Purchase) ← Xero

fields.description: Sync Xero Credit Notes into ERPNext return invoices.
fields.label: Credit Notes ← Xero

fields.description: Sync Xero Payments into ERPNext Payment Entries. Also enables the hourly payment detection task.
fields.label: Payments ← Xero

fields.description: Pull Xero Chart of Accounts into ERPNext Account records. Useful for initial setup.
fields.label: Chart of Accounts ← Xero

fields.description: Pull financial reports (Balance Sheet, P&L) from Xero into ERPNext.
fields.label: Financial Reports ← Xero
Setup Mode
fields.options:
Manual
Xero as Source
ERPNext as Source
fields.description: Manual: configure account mapping yourself.  Xero as Source: new ERPNext site adopting Xero — accounts are pulled from Xero and created in ERPNext automatically.  ERPNext as Source: existing ERPNext adopting Xero — ERPNext accounts are matched to Xero accounts and gaps are flagged for review.

fields.label: Mapping Status
fields.options:
Not Started
In Progress
Review Required
Complete
fields.description: Updated automatically when auto-mapping is run or confirmed.
Automatically create a Payment Entry in ERPNext when a linked invoice's payment is detected during scheduled sync.
fields.label: Create Payment Entry in ERPNext when Invoice is Paid in Xero

fields.description: Default Bank or Cash account to use in automatically created Payment Entries.
fields.label: Default Bank Account for Payments

fields.description: Auto-submit Payment Entries created from Xero. If unchecked they are created as Draft for manual review.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Payment Entries from Xero

fields.description: Days to retain Xero sync log entries before automatic cleanup.
fields.label: Log Retention Days

fields.description: Run scheduled sync tasks automatically (daily inbound, hourly payment check). Disable for manual-only sync.
fields.label: Enable Automatic Sync

fields.description: Enable real-time push notifications from Xero. Requires a publicly accessible webhook URL configured in the Xero Developer Portal.
fields.label: Enable Webhooks for Real-time Updates

fields.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed API calls before giving up.
fields.label: Max Retry Attempts

fields.description: Timeout in seconds for each Xero API request.
fields.label: API Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Log rate-limit headers for debugging. Disable on high-volume systems to reduce log noise.
fields.label: Enable Rate Limit Tracking

fields.description: Base (seconds) for exponential back-off when rate-limited. Delay = base ^ retry_count, capped by max delay.
fields.label: Backoff Base (seconds)

fields.description: Maximum back-off delay in seconds before giving up on a rate-limited request.
fields.label: Max Backoff Delay (seconds)
Directional Sync Warning
fields.options: Important: The directional master toggles act as safety gates. Disabling 'Sync TO Xero' prevents ALL writes to Xero, even if entity-level toggles are enabled.
